title: 1.5 Current Status of Physics
description: Recent discoveries in physics: exoplanets, black holes, gravitational waves, Higgs boson, JWST, and more

questions.question: What is an exoplanet?
options: A star too faint to be seen without a telescope
A planet in our solar system discovered after 2000
A planet orbiting a star outside our solar system
A moon orbiting a planet in the solar system
questions.correctAnswer: A planet orbiting a star outside our solar system

questions.question: Where was the first exoplanet detected?
The 2019 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded for the discovery of exoplanets to:
Why is the discovery of exoplanets significant?
options: It proved that stars emit light
It confirmed that planets exist around other stars
questions.correctAnswer: It confirmed that planets exist around other stars

questions.question: Which project produced the first-ever image of a black hole in 2019?
In which galaxy was the first image of a black hole captured?
The 2020 Nobel Prize in Physics for black hole research was awarded to:
options: Roger Penrose, Reinhard Genzel and Andrea Ghez
questions.correctAnswer: Roger Penrose, Reinhard Genzel and Andrea Ghez

questions.question: Genzel and Ghez observationally discovered a supermassive black hole at:
options: The edge of the solar system
The center of the Andromeda galaxy

questions.question: Quantum cryptography makes communication secure using:
options: The greenhouse effect and atmospheric radiation
Quantum entanglement and the no-cloning property of quantum states
questions.correctAnswer: Quantum entanglement and the no-cloning property of quantum states

questions.question: In quantum cryptography, how can eavesdropping be detected?
options: Observing a quantum state disturbs it
Eavesdroppers must warn the sender first
questions.correctAnswer: Observing a quantum state disturbs it

questions.question: What does the no-cloning property of quantum states mean?
options: A quantum key can be duplicated freely
A quantum state cannot be copied exactly
Quantum states can only exist inside accelerators
questions.correctAnswer: A quantum state cannot be copied exactly
